observations: Phone and Fold home screenshots display the original Lumo fox, principal navigation, learning/game cards and readable headings without visible overlapping main controls.
The original phone and Fold-cover journal empty-state screenshots show the complete heading, new-entry control and primary writing button.
The phone writing-task screenshot clearly displays the B exemplar, finger-writing call to action and next-task control.

The original Schreibcoach screenshot has a missing-glyph rectangle in its upper round badge, pale helper copy and a horizontally scrollable category row. The screenshot alone does not establish how the native Android font fallback behaves.
scope: Six selected actual Flutter renderer originals visually opened by root, not inspection of all 546 captures or an Android/physical-device test.
